verdict.rationale: Voice input and output are a fair axis for a chat interface like LibreChat, but nothing in the evidence pack documents speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or live voice conversations in LibreChat. The only voice mention (librechat-comm-5) describes TTS and microphone input in other frontends such as SillyTavern, not in LibreChat, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported
